text.content:
The nomad nation that learned to talk corpo.

Kind: Nomad nation
Base: Its shipping company, DTS
Purpose: Business

Meta could "speak corpo" and turned on the other nomad nations: its shipping company, DTS, undercut them and locked in exclusive contracts until it was the biggest freight carrier in North America.

Gig hooks

  • A DTS driver is carrying something off the manifest, and wants an escort for the last leg.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.28
